# Code block examples

Use these samples to verify language labels, syntax highlighting, horizontal overflow, and copying.

## JSON

```json
{
  "host": "localhost",
  "port": 8080,
  "features": ["search", "themes"]
}
```

## Bash

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
servef ./docs --port 8080
```

## Shell

```shell
servef ./docs --no-open
```

## Unknown language

```custom-format
unknown <syntax> remains safely escaped
```

## Unlabelled

```
plain text still supports copying
```
